name: Return to Dust
oracle_text: Exile target artifact or enchantment. If you cast this spell during your main phase, you may exile up to one other target artifact or enchantment.
blocked_sentences: If you cast this spell during your main phase, you may exile up to one other target artifact or enchantment.

needs.what: a target spec that is declared only when the spell is cast during a given phase -- e.g. `cast_during: "your_main"` on a card-level target (count 1, up_to, distinct from the first target), so a second 'up to one other target artifact or enchantment' exists only when the spell is cast in your main phase (601.2c)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `cast_during` condition exists but only as an `if` read at resolution. Target specs can be gated by `mode`, `cost_option`, `gift_promised` and `count_if_kicked`, none of which reads the phase the spell was cast in. Declaring an always-available optional second target and exiling it inside `if cast_during` would let the caster target a second permanent at instant speed outside the main phase (triggering ward, becomes_target and heroic-style effects) -- a different card.
